t: This is Kennington Road, a long straight road about a mile in length, running south through Lambeth from Westminster Bridge Road to Kennington Park Road. Two people connect to it. Edward Donovan, the Anglo-Irish writer and natural history illustrator, died here in 1837. He never travelled, but described and illustrated many species from other naturalists' collections, and his books sold well in his day. Sadly, he died penniless, leaving a large family destitute. Dame Alice Anne Wall, who was press secretary and later lady-in-waiting to Queen Elizabeth the Second, lived on this road.
